newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy May and June fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy May and June fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 0.5-percent and 1.0-percent sulphur low pour fuel oil for May and June delivery, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
CPC seeks to buy the 0.5-percent cargo for delivery May 16-30 to Keelung, Taichung or Shenao and the 1.0-percent cargo for June 6-25 delivery to the same ports.
The tender closes on April 9 and is valid for two days.
In CPC's last fuel oil tender, CPC bought 0.5-percent low-pour fuel oil at $131 per tonne and high-pour at $121 per tonne for May delivery, both on a cost-and-freigh basis to Taiwan.
